notes: Four distinct movable parts are supported by visible state changes. The two independently hinged upper-cabinet leaves are reported separately, although their closing transitions occur within the same 592–600 sampling interval.
scene_description: A user moves around a compact kitchen and manipulates the refrigerator door, two separate hinged leaves of the upper cabinet above the cooktop, and a pull-out drawer beside the oven.
